name: 施設の住所と評価を続けて読む詳細
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
ONE Lighthouse LH01-0085 施設の住所と評価を続けて読む詳細. Input1 original main composite; input2 DISTINCT original detail rows; input3 original review-summary chart; input4 original quote/portrait row; input5 native Japanese mock gives exact authored Japanese content/layout. Original sources override simplified mock icons, green stars/chart and info-questionmark.
Purewhite#FFFFFF compact vertical information panel. Intro exactly "地域で親しまれている公園です。散歩や休憩を楽しめます。". Then exactly FIVE detail rows with original glyph anatomy in coherent slate#526173, NO tinted icon circles:
1 source outlined LOCATION PIN with filled center; title "東京都渋谷区代々木", helper "住所と位置情報".
2 source outlined CLOCK with short/long hands; title "営業中・22:00まで" (営業中green, restink), helper "営業時間を確認"; source small downward chevron retained.
3 source STOREFRONT/department glyph (horizontal roof/awning, rectangular doorway), NOT house; title "公園内の施設", helper "交流広場・運動場".
4 source GLOBE with original landshapes, NOT newspaper/document; title "公式サイト", helper "施設の案内を見る".
5 source PLUS-CODE glyph: CENTER SMALL SQUARE + FOUR surrounding filled dots north/south/east/west, NOT two filterlines/plus; title "位置コード", helper "代々木・東京都渋谷区".
Use fine neutral inset row dividers. Japanese titles/intro REGULAR40014/24, helpers REGULAR40012/16, tracking0. No blanket bold. These are example adaptations, not actual verified park info.
Below section label exactly "評価の概要" Regular14/24. Rating "4.7" native Meiryo Bold20/28; count "14,868件" Regular12/16. Source FOUR full GOLD stars + fifth LEFT-HALF gold/right-halfgray star, notfivegreenfull. To right EXACTLY FIVE gold horizontal distribution bars over lightgray tracks, retain original relative lengths frominput3 (firstfull, second~20percent, third~4percent, fourth/fifthtinyunder1percent). Preserve source circled lowercase information "i" at right, NOT questionmark. No change to source count/rating/distribution.
ONE quote row below: original EXACT black-and-white circular reviewer portrait frominput4, same crop/content, no resynthesis or substitute person. Japanese quote exactly "「友人とゆっくり過ごせる、気持ちのよい公園です。」", Regular14/24, readable natural wrap. Under it metadata "129人が休憩について言及", Regular12/16 mutedgray. Original right-facing small CHEVRON at far right. Do not add second review, chips, buttons, tabs, title, claim/edit rows orother content beyond native composition.
Keep original portrait pixels and exact source icon anatomy/optical strokes. Heading/row spacing compact and legible; no enclosing card, broadmint, gradientglow or random icon colors. Flat frontal isolated raster candidate. Actual address/hours/rating/actions/portrait editability/runtime unverified.
reviewNotes: Five Japanese detail rows and source glyph anatomy,5gold bars,4full+halfstar,4.7/14868/129 and info-i restored. Utility icons stayed brightblue rather than coherent slate; section label became bold instead of Regular. Protected portrait resynthesized. Needs palette/type correction; source-media fidelity pending separately.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
